decisions.reason: As a multi-model formwork profile system tightly linked to our core modular engineering capabilities and retained for several years, it remains a strong fit for incremental improvement rather than withdrawal.

The automated concrete distributor flow control builds directly on our automation know-how and in-house R&D, so we are more likely to keep refining it than remove it despite its more limited market visibility.
Magnetic formwork strips are highly complementary to our established system business, and our accumulated technical and customer learning makes continued commercialization the more attractive option.
This magnetic formwork component is close to our existing knowledge base and product architecture, so our absorptive capacity and service ties support keeping it on the market.

Although this magnetic formwork component has weaker product prominence and may face portfolio rationalization risk, it is still sufficiently close to our core competencies that retention is more likely than exit.
